Subject: Equity top-up request: Mohit Patel — post-org consolidation

Team,

Following yesterday's org consolidation for Payments and Risk, Mohit Patel (Sr. Eng, Payments) now carries two streams worth of scope (payments ledger + settlement piping). We think there's a clear retention risk: he has two competitive inbound offers (recruiter flagged) and his current equity is below midpoint for the blended role.

As discussed with Rishi (his manager), I'm requesting a one-time equity top-up outside the normal refresh window under the "exceptional contribution / consolidation" policy. Proposal in the attached comp request:
- Type: RSU top-up (time-vested)
- Size: 0.5% (equity refresh budget line suggested)
- Rationale: retained ownership of cross-service feature set, critical on-call SME, key to Q3 payments migration

Attachments: comp_request_mohit_patel.xlsx, org_chart_before_after.pdf

Ask: Can I get provisional approval to route this to Finance and People Ops for sign-off? If helpful I can include a manager note and a short 3-bullet business justification.

Thanks,

Kim / Laura —

Adding the manager note asked for. Mohit has led both the ledger rewrite and the settlements migration for the last 9 months; below are the facts I used in the comp request spreadsheet.

Manager endorsement (summary):
- Performance & impact: Led delivery of Payment Ledger v2 (reduced failure-rate 38%), architected live settlement failover used during last incident.
- Business risk: Two inbound offers in the last six weeks (one with counter to start in Q3), Mohit has flagged higher base + equity. He is the single-point SME for both services during the migration window.
- Recommendation: Approve 0.5% RSU top-up (0.25% vests at 12 months, remaining 0.25% vests at 24 months) as a one-time exception — will be treated as replacement of expected refresh (not additive).

Budget offset: We have 0.3% of the Payments ops refresh pool available this quarter; remaining 0.2% would need to be reallocated from central refresh/retention budget.

I've attached an updated comp_request_mohit_patel.xlsx with manager comments and the proposed vest schedule.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk the numbers.

Thanks Rishi — I reviewed the spreadsheet. A couple notes from Comp team:

- Policy: One-time top-ups tied to documented consolidation/critical-skill retention are allowed, we need senior sign-off (VP People + Finance) and a one-paragraph business case for audit.
- Vesting: The 12/24 split is fine if we treat this as replacement of the standard refresh. Please ensure grant language ties to retention condition (standard clause).
- Budget: Finance will need to confirm the 0.2% reallocation. If Finance cannot reallocate, we can instead split the top-up with a smaller immediate RSU + a deferred refresh in Q4; let me know if that flexibility is acceptable.

Please prep a 2–3 sentence business justification and confirm if Rishi is comfortable with the alternative split. Once I have that, I'll route to Finance and tag Laura for VP approval.
